static_traits.name: Lin Mei
static_traits.social_status: Has three good friends but not yet sharing the sense of inferiority; feeling looked down upon when discussing cars with Male peers
static_traits.medical_history: No major medical illness; never received psychotherapy before; no similar problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, logically coherent, highly cooperative; positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: As a Female kid who loves sports cars, I feel I can never know sports cars like Males do, thus producing inferiority and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of inferiority are affecting my self-esteem and my enjoyment of hobbies.
growth_experiences: About two years ago began to be interested in sports cars; believing social stereotypes and the lack of Female representation in the auto industry are the main causes of the problem, this cognition gradually Reinforced into 'Female students cannot know cars like Male students', and worsened Self-doubt.

Often feeling looked down upon and judged when discussing racing topics with Male peers; once had positive discussions recognized by others in online forums, but these positive moments were overshadowed by negative experiences.

core_beliefs: I am a Female student, so I can never know sports cars as well as Males.

special_situations.event: Discussing sports car topics with Male peers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot talk fluently like them or show enough knowledge, I will be looked down upon, proving Female students are inherently not as knowledgeable about cars as Male students.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Researching extensively in advance to build knowledge reserves
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I do not know cars, looking down on me.

special_situations.event: Car-related topics coming up in any social situation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the topic involves cars and I cannot appear knowledgeable, I will be looked down upon and it will confirm I am not as good as others.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Joins online forums and does further research in an attempt to boost confidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time I will be looked down upon again, I will appear to be an outsider.

special_situations.event: Noticing fewer Female representatives in the car community and auto industry
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Females are rarely seen in this field, it shows Female students cannot reach the same knowledge level as Male students.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using 'Female scarcity' as evidence driving oneself to keep Learning to prove worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Female students are rare here, so I cannot be as knowledgeable as them.

special_situations.event: Has received recognition from others for his views in online forums
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If recognition is not gained in all situations, that positive feedback does not count.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores moments of being recognized; focuses more on negative experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These recognitions mean nothing, still showing I am not good enough.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be treated equally, recognized as a capable sports car enthusiast.
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being looked down upon or negated because of gender, worrying about being judged as an outsider.
defense_goal: Gains a sense of security through rational learning and preparation; reduces exposure and sharing in interpersonal settings to avoid being devalued.

object_relations.self_representation: An unrecognized outsider, a Female kid easily looked down upon
Capable enthusiast who can contribute ideas
object_relations.object_representation: Online community members who offer affirmation and acceptance

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When Male peers confidently discuss cars, showing familiarity
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting the other's confidence as belittling and contempt toward oneself (thinking they are looking down on oneself).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Calm tone, exploratory Questioning; first labeling and reflecting feelings of being looked down upon, then jointly examining evidence and alternative Interpretations, avoiding direct blame.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to do reality testing or discuss objective facts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses piling up rational-level information to isolate from emotions, believing 'as long as I learn enough I will be safe'.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts gentle, concrete emotion-focused language; invites them to describe present bodily and emotional experience, balancing fact-checking with emotional connection.

manifestations: Feeling that gender stereotypes have limited freely pursuing and expressing love for sports cars
Self-doubt in front of Male peers, hesitating to share interests
Having three good friends but not yet sharing own inferiority and distress
Hesitating to fully participate in the community
Hobbies overshadowed by negative self-evaluation, positive experiences ignored

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Internalizing the social stereotype 'Female students cannot know cars like Male students' as a self-standard
Defining own knowledge boundaries with gender rules

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally meant to be directed outward toward oneself, restraining outward seeking of others' support or action.
manifestations: Not yet sharing inferiority and distress with three close friends
Hesitating to participate in online car-enthusiast communities, Suppressing expression

contact_model.definition: Maladaptive self-Reflection and self-blame present, overly cautious in engagement.
manifestations: Overly cares about others' opinions; worries about being judged as a layman
Tending to negate own capability first in discussions

exception_events.target_problem: When discussing car topics with others, the client usually feels looked down upon and develops Self-doubt, thus hesitating to participate or reducing expression.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In some discussions on online forums, her views were appreciated and recognized by others, the exchange was smooth, and she experienced being affirmed.
exception_events.reason: Clue: previously did research, joined an online forum and shared specific views; the forum environment is more open, content-based interaction reduced gender bias, making this experience more positive.

positive_force: Sustained passion for sports cars and motivation to learn
Proactively researching and reading materials; accumulating knowledge
Has already joined online communities, has channels to expand participation
Has three close friends who can serve as potential support
Willing to seek counseling and try reality testing and cognitive restructuring
negative_force: Internalized gender stereotype belief (Female students not as knowledgeable about cars as Male students)
Excessively dependent on external evaluation; tends to seek external validation
Negating positive feedback, maladaptive cognitive patterns like overgeneralization and mind-reading
Inferiority and Self-doubt leading to hesitation in social expression
Self-esteem problems leading to Sleep disturbed

target_behavior.behavior: Showing inferiority and Self-doubt when car topics are involved, reducing expression/participation
antecedent: Car-related topics coming up in social settings
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized gender stereotypes and maladaptive cognitive patterns (mind-reading, overgeneralization, negating the positive), leading to interpreting others' confidence as belittling oneself.
target_behavior.function: Escaping the possibility of being judged and looked down upon, to reduce Anxiety and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, declining enjoyment of hobbies, social support not yet activated

target_behavior.behavior: Disturbed sleep patterns (e.g., Difficulty falling asleep, Declining sleep quality)
antecedent: After experiencing car-topic-related inferiority and Self-doubt during the day
The nighttime hours when negative thoughts are repeatedly activated
target_behavior.core_reason: Anxiety and ruminative thinking triggered by self-esteem problems and Persistent self-doubt.
target_behavior.function: Unintentional emotional processing and vigilance maintenance (maladaptive), trying to gain a sense of control through repeated thinking but backfiring
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient Recovery, further lowering emotion regulation and interest investment, forming a negative cycle
